name: Ostfildern (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically green and white, charged above the centre with the city arms of Ostfildern (a green mill wheel and a red cross).
history: Arms and the green-white striped flag, charged with the arms shifted upward, were granted by the Regierungspräsidium Stuttgart on 23 November 1976.

features.role: Ostfildern arms — mill wheel and cross
